dataset: OS OpenMap - Local Product Guide and Technical Specification - ImportantBuilding
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap - Local technical specification defines ImportantBuilding as a generalised building that belongs to a FunctionalSite. The ImportantBuilding feature has mandatory BuildingTheme, mandatory classification describing the site's actual function, optional distinctiveName, and mandatory geometry defined as a GM_Surface polygon representing the generalised important building. The selected public no-login source window is page 45 of the official product guide/technical specification; it contains feature-schema semantics only and no record-level Exeter feature, identifier or polygon coordinates. No spatial join, materialization or inferred building record was performed.

field_evidence.footprint: ImportantBuilding geometry is defined as a mandatory GM_Surface polygon representing the generalised important building.
field_evidence.type_use: ImportantBuilding carries mandatory BuildingTheme and classification (actual site function), with optional distinctiveName, in the same feature.
field_evidence.source_scope: Official public no-login Ordnance Survey product-guide page 45; schema-level feature definition only, with no individual Exeter ImportantBuilding record or polygon coordinates.
